blinding_guess.why: The plugin header includes <moveit_msgs/GetKinematicSolverInfo.h> (ur_moveit_plugin.h:89), but GetKinematicSolverInfo.srv is not in moveit_msgs at the kinetic release tag 0.9.1 (404 at both ros-planning/moveit_msgs@0.9.1 and ros-gbp release/kinetic/moveit_msgs/0.9.1-0). The generated header would not exist, so the package would fail to build against kinetic moveit_msgs. The include is otherwise unused, so it is a stale reference to a removed type. package.xml also declares no direct moveit_msgs dependency.

notes: All six packet elements are consumed as C++ message/service types inside the MoveIt kinematics plugin (class ur_kinematics::URKinematicsPlugin, base kinematics::KinematicsBase, exported via ur_moveit_plugins.xml). The package advertises, subscribes to, and calls no topics or services, so QoS/rate are null (ROS 1, none set) and nothing is provided: declares and not_declared are empty. GetPositionFK, GetPositionIK and GetKinematicSolverInfo appear only as #include lines (ur_moveit_plugin.h:87-89); no symbol from them is used. Their frame is null because the package never exchanges these services (the FK definition carries a Header whose frame_id would be per message). Used members: JointLimits.min_position/max_position (ur_moveit_plugin.cpp:244-245, 660-674); KinematicSolverInfo.joint_names/limits/link_names (cpp:222-237, 827, 832); MoveItErrorCodes.val with constants NO_IK_SOLUTION (cpp:570,576,582,775), TIMED_OUT (cpp:609), SUCCESS (cpp:734,736). Units for JointLimits are null: the definition states no units; the code wraps solutions by 2*M_PI against the limits (cpp:666-674), which implies radians but does not state them. Other referenced elements outside the packet (not listed in references): geometry_msgs/Pose, geometry_msgs/PoseStamped, the kinematics::KinematicsBase API, and private params max_solver_iterations, epsilon, <group>/position_only_ik, arm_prefix, ik_weights read by the plugin itself (cpp:253-255, 326, 372-373). package.xml (version 1.1.9) lists moveit_core, moveit_kinematics, moveit_ros_planning, roscpp, geometry_msgs, pluginlib, tf_conversions, boost; no moveit_msgs build/run depend, and CMakeLists.txt does not name moveit_msgs. Dependency tag: moveit_msgs 0.9.1 taken as the kinetic release (ros-gbp/moveit_msgs-release tag release/kinetic/moveit_msgs/0.9.1-0 exists and its files are byte-identical to ros-planning/moveit_msgs@0.9.1; 0.9.1-1 and upstream 0.9.2 return 404). GetKinematicSolverInfo definition is not available at that tag (msg/ and srv/ paths both 404), so its definition_id is null. Disclosure: while probing which tag is the kinetic release I also fetched the same files at the earlier kinetic release tag 0.9.0, where srv/GetKinematicSolverInfo.srv does exist; no field in this record uses that tag. definition_hash.py ros1 supports only .msg, so the two .srv ports carry sha256_normalised of the .srv text. The tool locates the package name from a package.xml; a minimal local package.xml containing only <name>moveit_msgs</name> was written next to the fetched files in the session scratchpad (nothing fetched beyond .msg/.srv).
